name: Solderless breadboard, full size (830 tie points)
summary: Full-size solderless breadboard: 830 tie points on a 2.54 mm (0.1 in) square grid, 165 x 55 x 9 mm, with power rails along both long edges.
description: Full-size breadboard with 830 contacts: a centre channel, two terminal banks and four power rails. The visible contact layout is schematic; the solid export keeps the body envelope.
source: Sizes checked by opening two product pages and reading retailer listings from web search: the generic listings that publish this size say 6.5 x 2.2 x 0.3 in (165 x 55 x 9 mm), which is the figure used here; BusBoard's own BB830 page gives 165.1 x 54.6 x 8.5 mm and SparkFun's full-size board 165.1 x 54.3 x 9.7 mm. So 165 x 55 x 9 mm is the class figure every listing rounds to, not a measurement - expect about a millimetre of variation between makers, and treat the height especially as approximate. The hole pattern was checked against those same two pages plus a listing found in search: BusBoard describes a 630 tie-point IC area plus four 50-point power rails (two 100-point distribution strips), SparkFun describes 63 rows x 10 columns with two split power buses, and a third listing gives 63 rows, 10 columns and 200 rail points - all of which add to 830. Pitch is 2.54 mm (0.1 in), the one figure every source agrees on. Rail splitting, row numbering and edge margins vary by manufacturer; the preview uses the nominal 830-point arrangement. The preview adds a schematic 2.54 mm contact layout, not a manufacturer-specific drill pattern. The export is the body envelope.
